newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAPAN TO BUY 20,000 TONNES OF RICE ON AUGUST 20.
newsitem.headline: JAPAN TO BUY 20,000 TONNES OF RICE ON AUGUST 20.

text.p: Japan's Food Agency said on Monday it would buy 20,000 tonnes of foreign rice at its import tender on August 20.
The tender, to be carried out under the Simultaneous Buy-and-Sell (SBS) system, will be the third tender for the fiscal year to March 31, 1998.
Under the GATT Uruguay Round agreements in 1993, Japan is required to import 530,600 tonnes of rice this fiscal year.
The Food Agency is Japan's sole importer of rice, wheat and barley.
